verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Unity offers programmable automation surfaces that could drive bulk work. These include public scripting APIs and editor extension, Asset Database management, batchmode command-line automation, and an MCP server and CLI (`unity <command>`/`unity eval`) that let agents automate workflows in the Editor directly. Build Automation also builds for multiple platforms at once. None of this explicitly documents applying one operation across many assets or objects; bulk capability is only implied through scripting. Missing for 10: explicit documented batch or multi-item operations (e.g., bulk asset or object edits via the CLI/MCP or API), examples of agent-driven bulk changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
